name: Land survey
summary: Boundary surveys priced from corners to locate and set, terrain, research, drafting and crew travel.

items.label: Locate existing corners
items.source: 25 field min per corner x moderate terrain 1.4 (calc.mjs); drafting 20 min per corner at $55/h counted as cost; 3 corners default

items.label: Set new corners
items.source: 55 field min per corner x 1.4; drafting 20 min at $55/h as cost; specialist prices no monument material; 1 corner default

items.label: Record research (office)
items.source: 3 office hours at $85/h (DEFAULTS), entered as cost because it is not field-crew time

items.label: Plat drafting base
items.source: 2 base drafting hours at $55/h (DEFAULTS), entered as cost

items.label: Crew travel, round trip
items.source: 40 round-trip miles at 40 mph = 1 crew hour (0.5 h minimum); $0.67 per mile (DEFAULTS)

specialistModels: Uses separate field, office and drafting rates, a terrain multiplier, a rush surcharge, an $850 minimum fee and a per-acre quote comparison.
